feed.title: Google Cloud: API Keys API
feed.subtitle: Changelog for Google Cloud product: API Keys API

entry.content:
The API Keys remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server is available in Preview. You can connect to the API Keys remote MCP server from AI applications to create, inspect, restrict, and manage the lifecycle of API keys in your Google Cloud projects.

For more information, see the API Keys MCP reference.
entry.summary: The API Keys remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server is now available in preview. This allows AI applications to manage API keys within your Google Cloud projects, including creation, inspection, restriction, and lifecycle management.
entry.title: Feature: API Keys Remote MCP Server Now in Preview
